definitions.explanation: Money that is owed or borrowed.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{借金|しゃっきん}をした。
examples.english: I borrowed money from a friend.
examples.notes: 借金をする = to borrow money, to go into debt

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}を{返|かえ}さなければならない。
examples.english: I have to pay back my debt.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{事業|じぎょう}に{失敗|しっぱい}して{多額|たがく}の{借金|しゃっきん}を{抱|かか}えることになった。{返済|へんさい}のために{昼夜|ちゅうや}{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: He failed in business and ended up with a large debt. He works day and night to pay it back.

notes:
{借金|しゃっきん} refers to debt or the act of borrowing money.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {借金|しゃっきん}をする (to borrow money, to incur debt)
- {借金|しゃっきん}を{返|かえ}す (to repay debt)
- {借金|しゃっきん}を{抱|かか}える (to carry debt)
- {借金|しゃっきん}が{増|ふ}える (debt increases)
- {借金|しゃっきん}を{完済|かんさい}する (to pay off debt completely)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多額|たがく}の{借金|しゃっきん} (large debt)
- {借金|しゃっきん}{返済|へんさい} (debt repayment)
- {借金|しゃっきん}{取|と}り (debt collector)
- {借金|しゃっきん}{苦|く} (suffering from debt)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {借金|しゃっきん}: personal debt/loan (informal borrowing)
- {負債|ふさい}: liabilities, debt (formal/accounting term)
- ローン: loan (from a bank or financial institution)
